summary_bullets: Normalize sibling boolean-flag invalid-argv handling to match --manual-gate-b (exit 2 + larch_err)
Add symmetric negative tests for --partition-requested and --brainstorm-requested missing/empty values
Document all three boolean flags' present non-empty value requirement in the contract doc
commit_message:
Normalize sibling router flag invalid-argv rejection via require_value

Route --partition-requested, --brainstorm-requested, and --manual-gate-b through a shared require_value helper so missing or empty argv yields exit 2 with the same larch_err message. Add four symmetric negative harness cases and sync write-run-params.md.
